2713-3755-4687.easyPrerequisites: Gilder Bairn does not have summoning sickness.
2713-3755-4687.description:
Activate Gilder Bairn's ability from Elven Chorus by tapping it, adding {G/U}.
Activate Gilder Bairn by paying {G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on target permanent.
Repeat.

6761-7084-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, it and Scouring Swarm trigger.
Resolve the land's trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Resolve the Scouring Swarm trigger, untapping it and creating a creature token.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.
6761-7084-8095.notes: If you have seven or more land cards in your graveyard, this combo can create infinite creature tokens if you start it with two or more Scouring Swarms.

277-851-4365-4772-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Tiller Engine triggers eight times, untapping the New Planets.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

654-1308-4365-7824-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers eight times, untapping the New Planets.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

2173-4496-5220-7192.description:
Cast Accursed Centaur by paying its mana cost.
Activate Accursed Centaur by sacrificing it.
When Accursed Centaur dies, Mortuary and Grave Venerations trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Accursed Centaur from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Grave Venerations trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Cast Accursed Centaur from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

2034-5224-6294-7646.description:
Cast Marketback Walker by paying {1}, causing it to enter the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, targeting Marketback Walker.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Marketback Walker, adding {C}{C}.
When Marketback Walker dies, Together Forever triggers, returning Marketback Walker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2350-4499-7494.description:
Cast a copy of Seething Song from exile by paying no more than {1}{R}, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Activate Emiel the Blessed by paying {3}, blinking Blazing Firesinger, which enters prepared.
Repeat.

3258-5900-7417.description:
If Beacon of Tomorrows is in your library, cast a copy of Wild Idea by paying {3}{U}{R}, searching your library for Beacon of Tomorrows and putting it into your hand.
If Sanar doesn't have summoning sickness, activate it by tapping it, creating a Treasure token. Then, activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Beacon of Tomorrows by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and shuffle Beacon of Tomorrows into your library.
Blink Sanar using Lilysplash Mentor. It'll enter prepared due to its static effect.
Repeat each turn.
3258-5900-7417.notes: If Beacon of Tomorrows is in your hand to start, you can skip step 1 the first iteration and save {3}{U}{R} during that iteration. If Sanar starts with summoning sickness, you need an additional {U} the first iteration.

1669-6871-6879-7298.description:
Cast Firdoch Core by paying {3}.
When Firdoch Core enters, Haru triggers, earthbending Firdoch Core, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Thaumatog by sacrificing Firdoch Core.
When Firdoch Core dies, Haru triggers, returning Firdoch Core from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Firdoch Core enters, Haru triggers, earthbending Firdoch Core, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Thaumatog ability.
Repeat from step 3.

3151-7282-7340.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five Elves.
3151-7282-7340.description:
Activate Elvish Archdruid by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}{G}
Activate Chrome Dome by paying {5}, creating a token copy of Sewer-veillance Cam.
When the Sewer-veillance Cam token enters, it triggers, untapping Elvish Archdruid.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-4742-5485.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control
3259-4742-5485.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury and Orochi Soul-Reaver trigger.
Resolve the Orochi Soul-Reaver trigger, creating a Treasure token and causing you to manifest the top card of the damaged opponent's library.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the manifested card, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

628-5147-7215.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Gnarlbark Elm.
When Gnarlbark Elm dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability
Repeat.

3532-3594-5078-5901.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Toothy triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

1850-5412-6850.description:
Activate Coastal Hornclaw by sacrificing a land.
Play the land from your graveyard.
Repeat.
1850-5412-6850.notes: If the land can tap for mana once it enters the battlefield, you can do so for infinite mana.

2390-2919-6320.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to give a creature lifelink.
You have a way to gain life.
2390-2919-6320.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Saheeli triggers, causing you to pay {E}{E}{E} to create a token copy of All Will Be One that is a creature.
Give the All Will Be One token lifelink.
Gain life in any way.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
The All Will Be One token triggers, dealing 1 damage to an opponent and causing you to gain at least 1 life.
Repeat from step 4.

586-3771-5258-5618-6797.description:
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Priest of Gix.
When Priest of Gix dies, Rakdos triggers.
Holding priority, activate Haunted Crossroads by paying {B}, putting Priest of Gix from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Rakdos trigger, causing you to exile the top three cards of your library with the ability to play them until your next end step.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability from step 1.
Cast Priest of Gix from exile by paying at most {2}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

338-4186-6719.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
338-4186-6719.description:
Gain life.
Light of Promise triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Dazzling Angel triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1330-6758.easyPrerequisites: You control a creature that can attack this turn.
1330-6758.notablePrerequisites: Dawnsire has ten or more charge counters on it.
1330-6758.description:
Declare any creature as an attacker. Dawnsire triggers, dealing 100 damage to  Truefire Captain.
Truefire Captain triggers, dealing 100 damage to target player.

1563-2351-4927-6460.easyPrerequisites:
You control a token.
It is an opponent's turn.
1563-2351-4927-6460.description:
Activate Hardened Tactician by paying {1} and sacrificing a token.
If you sacrificed a Tentacle, The Watcher's second ability triggers if the creature token was a Tentacle, untapping a Kraken and putting a stun counter on up to one nonland permanent.
Resolve the Hardened Tactician ability, causing you to draw a card.
The Watcher's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Activate the Tentacle by tapping it, adding {G}.
Repeat.

579-1491-3755-6218.easyPrerequisites: Sinking Feeling attached to Pheres-Band Tromper.
579-1491-3755-6218.notablePrerequisites: Pheres-Band Tromper does not have summoning sickness.
579-1491-3755-6218.description:
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by tapping it, adding two mana of any color.
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by paying {1} and putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Pheres-Band Tromper triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

3836-5078-5741.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

2342-2512-4361.description:
Activate Shaman en-Kor's first ability by paying {0}, targeting Daru Spiritualist.
Daru Spiritualist triggers, causing itself to get +0/+2 until end of turn.
Resolve the Shaman en-Kor ability, causing the next one damage dealt to Shaman en-Kor this turn to be dealt to Daru Spiritualist instead.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Activate Miren's second ability by paying {3}, tapping it and sacrificing Daru Spiritualist, causing you to gain life equal to Daru Spiritualist's toughness.

413-1267-4897.notablePrerequisites:
Medomai in your graveyard.Olivia does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent is unable to block your creatures.
413-1267-4897.description:
Declare Olivia as an attacker, attacking an opponent unable to block your creatures.
Olivia triggers, returning Medomai from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking that opponent.
When Medomai enters the battlefield, Blasting Station triggers, untapping itself.
Deal combat damage with Medomai, triggering its ability, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Medomai, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.

2034-3627-4875.notablePrerequisites:
Avacyn's Collar attached to any creature you control.
"Human" chosen with Conspiracy.
2034-3627-4875.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the creature with Avacyn's Collar attached, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Avacyn's Collar triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Activate Avacyn's Collar's equip ability by paying {2}, attaching it to the Spirit token.
Repeat.

1089-1339-2804.notablePrerequisites:
Curiosity attached to Witty Roastmaster.
You have a way to draw a card.
1089-1339-2804.description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
The Insect enters the battlefield, triggering Witty Roastmaster, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Curiosity triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

575-2034-2345.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken land creature.
575-2034-2345.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a nontoken land creature, adding {C}{C}.
The land creature dies, triggering Yedora, returning it to the battlefield face down as a Forest land.
The Forest enters the battlefield, triggering Embodiment of Insight, causing the Forest to become a 3/3 Elemental creature with haste in addition to its other types.
Activate the Elemental by tapping it, adding {G}.
Repeat.

2493-3557-4377.notablePrerequisites:
Brago does not have summoning sickness.
Brago can not be blocked.
2493-3557-4377.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying {4}{U}{U}, getting an extra turn after this one.
Move to your combat phase.
Deal combat damage with Brago, blinking Archaeomancer.
Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, returning Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn.
Repeat.

527-1909-2232-2951.notablePrerequisites:
Selvala and Leaf Gilder do not have summoning sickness.
You control a creature with power five or greater.
527-1909-2232-2951.description:
Activate Leaf Gilder by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {2}{G}{G}{G}.
Activate Wirewood Symbiote by returning Leaf Gilder to your hand, untapping Selvala.
Cast Leaf Gilder by paying {1}{G}.
Leaf Gilder enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio, returning Wirewood Symbiote to your hand.
Cast Wirewood Symbiote by paying {G}.
Wirewood Symbiote enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio, returning nothing to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.
